# google-classroom-student-mcp

> Free, open source, read only MCP server that lets AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot and others) read a student's Google Classroom courses, due dates, grades and announcements. It cannot submit, edit or delete anything.

## Setup
- Needs GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN.
- Run the one time login command from the README to get a refresh token.
- Run with npx -y google-classroom-student-mcp. Run `npx google-classroom-student-mcp doctor` to check the setup.

## Tools (all read only)
- get_my_courses: List the student's active Google Classroom classes with their IDs.
- get_todo: Everything assigned that the student has not turned in yet. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes.
- get_upcoming_due_dates: Work that is due soon and not turned in, soonest first. Pass course_ids or days_ahead to narrow it, or leave both empty.
- get_missing_assignments: Past due work that has not been turned in. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes.
- get_assignments: Assignments for one class with due dates and status.
- get_my_grades: Grades on returned work for each class. Google Classroom has no overall grade, so this adds up graded work only. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes.
- get_announcements: Recent announcements. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes.
- get_course_materials: Posted materials for one class.

get_todo, get_upcoming_due_dates, get_missing_assignments and get_my_grades take an optional course_ids list to check specific classes only. get_upcoming_due_dates also takes an optional days_ahead number. get_announcements takes optional course_ids too.
